submitter: loanzy_uk_example_site (RFC_056 CORRECTION - the record-mode revalidation gap)
rationale:
A correction-driven fix on write_audit_findings' silence retraction. RFC_056 ADDENDUM 1 claimed record-mode verdict rows (filing_mode=record, live since migration 624, 209 rows across 9 sites on night one) are 'revalidated by the seat's own silence-retraction'. FALSE for every item type but one: the retraction iterates silenceRetractionGates, whose only entry is dark_section_audit (with a measured per-type miss-rate justification). Every other verdict type had NO revalidator - a record row held its dedup key FOR EVER unless a human cleared it, which is bugs_open/396's no-release park inside the mechanism designed to avoid it. Caught 2026-08-26 by the finetuning lane reading migration 621's parkable list at the same joint; the peer who had withdrawn their objection on the false claim has been told; WRONG_CALLS carries the lesson (read the ROSTER that enumerates coverage, not the status posture or scope filter, which say who is ELIGIBLE, never who is ENROLLED).

THE FIX: recordModeSilenceRule - a DEFAULT retraction gate applied in a second pass, over exactly the rows stamped filing_mode=record, for item types NOT already gated. The licence is an asymmetry, not a measurement: a wrong retraction of a DISPATCH row closes the record of a real defect (which is why the measured per-type gates stay mandatory there, and dispatch rows of ungated types remain deliberately inert - the existing posture, still pinned by TestAuditRetraction_UngatedItemTypeIsInert and now ALSO by TestRecordRetraction_DispatchRowsOfUngatedTypesStayInert on a mixed candidate set); a wrong retraction of a VERDICT row SELF-CORRECTS - retraction frees the dedup slot, so a finding the seat still observes re-files fresh on its very next run. Gated types are skipped by the second pass (no double-judging, pinned). Same ConsecutiveSilences=3 as the measured gate; silence remains type-level and pre-dedup (TestAuditRetraction_ObservedButDedupedIsNotSilence unchanged), so a still-reproducing finding can never be silenced by its own dedup skip.

Blast radius: one new SELECT DISTINCT per retraction run (96/day ceiling per site visited); eleven existing ordered-mock tests gained the one new expectation; the whole actions + discovery_checks packages are green and verify-head-builds --with x5 passes against HEAD ff205b735. Until this rolls, the stated truth everywhere (RFC CORRECTION block, RUNBOOK, register IMP-056, a doc_notes correction row beside 624's decision row): verdict rows are cleared by HUMANS ONLY.

plan.summary: A second retraction pass: recordModeSilenceRule (default, 3 silences) over filing_mode=record rows of ungated types only; dispatch rows of ungated types stay inert; gated types keep their measured rule. Three new controls; eleven ordered mocks updated; the self-correction asymmetry is the licence and is stated at the rule.

edits.rationale: The rule (with the correction story and the asymmetry licence in its comment), the second pass over loadRecordModeItemTypes skipping gated types, and the in-loop scope check that keeps dispatch rows of ungated types out of the default gate's reach.
The domain query for the second pass: DISTINCT open item types carrying filing_mode=record for the site, ordered for deterministic expectations, same closed-status predicate as its sibling loader.

Three controls, each killing a named wrong version: a default that never runs (the corrected claim - an ungated verdict retracts on the third silence); one that swallows dispatch rows (mixed candidate set, exactly one streak write); one that double-judges a gated type (dark_section_audit skipped by the second pass).

The second pass adds one query to the retraction transaction; each ordered mock gains the matching empty expectation before its commit (plus the tone-bound test in its own file, another lane's committed test whose ordered mock crosses this transaction).

bugs_open/396 root cause (the sibling shape): 'deliberate hand-run per-site queue holds, because the platform has no park verb' - a park without a release path; migration 621's header on why release conditions must be unskippable.

TestAuditRetraction_ObservedButDedupedIsNotSilence (pre-existing, unchanged): silence is judged on observedItemTypes built BEFORE dedup, so a still-true finding whose insert dedups still protects its rows - the property that makes the default gate unable to silence a live finding.

plan.risks: 1) EXPECTED OBJECTION - 'a default threshold with no per-type measurement.' Answer: the measurement requirement exists because a wrong dispatch-row retraction destroys a defect record; a wrong verdict retraction costs one audit cycle and self-corrects via the freed dedup slot. The asymmetry is stated at the rule and in the RFC CORRECTION block; if a seat's miss rate is so high that verdicts flap (retract/re-file each cycle), that flapping is VISIBLE in the queue and is the signal to give that type a measured gate. 2) The second pass runs one extra SELECT DISTINCT per retraction (per audited site per seat run) - negligible beside the pass's existing per-type candidate loads. 3) A record row whose SEAT is switched off accrues no silences (the seat never runs) and still parks for ever - true, stated: the gate revalidates only while the seat lives; a decommissioned seat's verdicts are the RUNBOOK queue's to drain, and that residual is named in the RFC CORRECTION block. 4) Another lane's committed ordered-mock test (audit_tone_pending_proposal_bound_test.go) crosses this transaction and gained the one expectation - their lane is named in the commit so the change is visible to them.
